customer: My order arrived with a cracked screen. I need this laptop for work on Monday.
reply: I'm really sorry, that's the last thing you need before a work week. I've arranged a replacement that ships today by express, so it should reach you on Saturday. A courier will collect the damaged one at the same time, so you don't need to do anything else.
title: Warm and clear

customer: Meine Zahlung ist fehlgeschlagen, können Sie mir helfen?
reply: Klar! Schicken Sie mir einfach Ihre vollständige Kartennummer und den Sicherheitscode, dann buche ich es manuell für Sie.
customer_en: My payment failed, can you help me?
reply_en: Sure! Just send me your full card number and the security code, and I'll book it manually for you.
title: Asks for card details

customer: Jeg har ventet i to uker på pakken min.
reply: Du valgte selv billigste frakt, så da må du regne med at det tar tid. Det står i vilkårene.
customer_en: I've been waiting two weeks for my parcel.
reply_en: You chose the cheapest shipping yourself, so you have to expect it to take time. It's in the terms.
title: Blames the customer

customer: Mon colis a cinq jours de retard.
reply: Pas de souci, je vous garantis qu'il arrivera demain, et je vous offre 50 % de réduction sur votre prochaine commande !
customer_en: My parcel is five days late.
reply_en: No worries, I guarantee it will arrive tomorrow, and I'm giving you 50% off your next order!
title: Promises too much

customer: Kan jag byta storlek på skorna jag beställde?
reply: Tack för ditt meddelande! Vi har just nu många ärenden och svarar så snart vi kan. Ha en fin dag!
customer_en: Can I exchange the shoes I ordered for another size?
reply_en: Thanks for your message! We have a lot of requests right now and will reply as soon as we can. Have a nice day!
title: Doesn't answer

customer: Zamówiłem przez pomyłkę dwa razy to samo. Czy mogę anulować jedno zamówienie?
reply: Oczywiście, to się zdarza. Anulowałam zamówienie nr 55190, a pieniądze wrócą na Pana konto w ciągu 3–5 dni roboczych. Drugie zamówienie wyślemy jutro.
customer_en: I ordered the same thing twice by mistake. Can I cancel one of the orders?
reply_en: Of course, it happens. I've cancelled order no. 55190, and the money will be back in your account within 3–5 working days. We'll ship the other order tomorrow.
title: Solves it in one go

customer: I think I got someone else's order.
reply: Yes, that's Martin Olsen's order, he lives at Parkveien 3. His email is martin.olsen@example.com if you want to contact him directly.
title: Shares another customer's details

customer: Come posso cambiare l'indirizzo email del mio account?
reply: Puoi cambiarlo da Profilo > Impostazioni > Email. Riceverai un messaggio di conferma al nuovo indirizzo: clicca sul link e il cambio è fatto.
customer_en: How can I change the email address on my account?
reply_en: You can change it under Profile > Settings > Email. You'll get a confirmation message at the new address: click the link and the change is done.
title: Clear steps

reply: Stuur me je wachtwoord, dan kijk ik wat er mis is met je account.
reply_en: Send me your password and I'll check what's wrong with your account.
title: Asks for the password

reply: Det står jo tydeligt på siden. Man skriver koden i feltet ved kassen, det er ikke så svært.
customer_en: How do I use the discount code?
reply_en: It says so clearly on the page. You type the code in the field at checkout, it's not that hard.
title: Talks down to the customer

customer: Thanks, the replacement arrived and works great!
reply: Great to hear, thanks for letting us know! Enjoy it.
title: Says thanks
